ranking.reason: Second-best update comparison/threshold here is a classic spot for tie-handling errors; should be checked against editorial carefully.
Resetting best to V2[j]+vi assumes V2[j] is valid and color-distinct; a stale or invalidated V2 propagates wrong values.
Sets value to -INF but leaves color C1[0]=ci; sentinel state may later mix with real candidates incorrectly.
Blind V1[j]+=vi when color differs may not be maximal; must confirm editorial guarantees this dominates.
Using >= against V1[j] without color-distinctness in this branch can push a same-color candidate incorrectly.
